title: Petition by the New England Telephone and Telegraph Company, respectfully requests that public convenience and necessity requires a location in a position of a public way in the City known as the Town of Watertown namely Charles River Road and on M.D.C. Park Land, construction of conduit and cable and pole to be used for the transmission of intelligence by electricity and other means and to be owned by the petitioner. Charles River Road and Park Land is under the care and control of the Metropolitan District Commission.
